color.note: A single dark theme, by design: the interface is a holographic HUD over a 3D scene and declares color-scheme dark. There is no light theme in the source.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The page ground, also the theme-color. Never seen flat: the vignette and scanlines sit over it.

tokens.name: interface
tokens.usage: The fixed interface cyan. Anything neutral pins to it; the particle field is drawn in it; panel-default restates it.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The live accent. The HUD root re-declares it per phase (phase-*), each panel per card (panel-*). Every border, glow and tint is written against accent, never against a phase token.

tokens.name: scanline
tokens.usage: The 1px-on-3px scanline over the whole frame (body::after).

tokens.name: vignette
tokens.usage: Edge of the radial falloff over the scene, from transparent at 30%.

tokens.name: phase-offline
tokens.usage: accent while offline: the machine is off. Reactor, instruments and HUD together.

tokens.name: phase-boot
tokens.usage: accent during the boot sequence.

tokens.name: phase-dormant
tokens.usage: accent on standby, waiting for the wake word.

tokens.name: phase-waking
tokens.usage: accent for the instant after the wake word: the brightest cyan.

tokens.name: phase-listening
tokens.usage: accent while listening. Also the diagnostics overlay's fallback border.

tokens.name: phase-thinking
tokens.usage: accent while processing: amber reads as effort.

tokens.name: phase-tooling
tokens.usage: accent while a tool runs: violet reads as machinery.

tokens.name: phase-speaking
tokens.usage: accent while responding: green reads as voice. Same value as diag-ok.

tokens.name: panel-amber
tokens.usage: A panel's accent when the model asks for amber. Holds once the card has landed.

tokens.name: panel-violet
tokens.usage: A panel's accent when the model asks for violet.

tokens.name: panel-green
tokens.usage: A panel's accent when the model asks for green.

tokens.name: panel-red
tokens.usage: A panel's accent when the model asks for red. Same value as error.

tokens.name: ink-label
tokens.usage: Primary text in a HUD row (hud-label) on the panel tint over bg.

tokens.name: ink-reply
tokens.usage: JARVIS's transcript lines (log-jarvis), with glow-reply, on bg.

tokens.name: ink-note
tokens.usage: Prose in a panel (hud-note) at dim-note, on the panel tint.

tokens.name: ink-metric
tokens.usage: The big figure (hud-metric) with glow-metric.

tokens.name: ink-tool
tokens.usage: The running tool's name in the chip (tool-name) with glow-tool-name.

tokens.name: ink-boot
tokens.usage: Boot readout title and the J.A.R.V.I.S name on the reticle; reactor triangle stroke. Same value as reader-title.

tokens.name: ink-blade
tokens.usage: The tool name carried across the blade sweep (blade-tool).

tokens.name: ink-reactor-lit
tokens.usage: A lit segment of the boot reactor ring (boot-r-on).

tokens.name: ink-caption
tokens.usage: The live partial transcript while listening (caption), shown at dim-caption. The only pure white.

tokens.name: ignition-ink
tokens.usage: Text and ring on the ignition gate, before any phase exists. Glows with glow-ignition.

tokens.name: ignition-core
tokens.usage: Centre of the ignition gate's radial ground, fading to bg at 70%.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: The one-line error under the transcript, on bg. 4.6:1.

tokens.name: camera-live
tokens.usage: The pulsing dot in the camera indicator (hands-live), with its own 8px glow.

tokens.name: reactor-core
tokens.usage: The 3D reactor shader's base colour (uColor) and the reader view's quote rule and scrollbar.

tokens.name: reactor-hot
tokens.usage: The 3D reactor shader's hot core (uHot).

tokens.name: reactor-vector
tokens.usage: The dark V stroke inside the boot reactor triangle (boot-r-v).

tokens.name: surface-chip
tokens.usage: Ground of the tool chip, mixed 9% with accent, under backdrop-chip.

tokens.name: surface-blade
tokens.usage: Top of a blade's gradient, mixed 11% with accent, under backdrop-blade.

tokens.name: surface-blade-deep
tokens.usage: Bottom of a blade's gradient, mixed 4% with accent.

tokens.name: surface-live
tokens.usage: Ground of the camera indicator, mixed 10% with accent, under backdrop-live.

tokens.name: surface-guide
tokens.usage: Ground of the gesture legend, mixed 8% with accent, under backdrop-guide.

tokens.name: surface-diag
tokens.usage: Ground of the diagnostics overlay, under backdrop-diag.

tokens.name: surface-media
tokens.usage: Behind a video, an embed or the mirrored camera while it loads.

tokens.name: surface-media-dim
tokens.usage: Letterbox behind a contained image or video in a blade.
